title: Shows on Decatur Street
summary: He did not play shows on Decatur Street; the clubs had two bands.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I was gonna ask you about shows and stuff on Decatur Street. Did you play for any shows down there?
No, I didn't. I wasn't close on Bunn Street where they had shows, but we couldn't play any shows. She only had two bands in the club. Well, we used to do a white band, I'm pretty sure.
One guy wanted two. They got about ten people back there.
